name: Fungal Bed
text:
This card can't be put into deck.

This card/Nexus' LV cost can't be changed by opposing effects, including when it is put onto the Field.

[LV1]
When your "Fungal Tree" family Spirits are depleted/destroyed by opposing effects, by destroying this Nexus, send a core from your Trash, besides Soul Core, to that target. The target that has core put onto it via this effect remains on the Field, exhausted.
note: Token Nexus (v514): sent out by SEND_TOKEN, returns to the Token supply when it leaves the Field. The LV1 replacement effect is not modelled yet.
